name: How do I clean black soot off my walls effectively?

mainEntity.name: How do I clean black soot off my walls effectively?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning black soot requires a gentle but thorough approach. For light soot, you can try using a dry chemical sponge to lift the soot without smearing. Avoid using water or liquid cleaners initially, as they can set the soot into the paint. For heavier soot, a specialized soot cleaner designed to break down carbon particles may be necessary. Always test any cleaning method in an inconspicuous area first. For extensive soot, particularly from fires, professional restoration is often required to prevent damage and ensure complete removal.
